saints.name: St. Narcissus of Jerusalem
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: A bishop of Jerusalem famed for holiness and miracles who lived to an extreme old age…
biography: Narcissus became bishop of Jerusalem in the latter part of the second century, already advanced in years. Eusebius, the early historian, records the veneration in which he was held and the wonders attributed to him, among them the changing of water into oil for the lamps of the church one Easter vigil.

Slandered by his enemies, he withdrew for a time into solitude, but was restored to his people when the falsehood was exposed. He is said to have governed his church to well past the age of a hundred, and to have shared its rule at the last with St. Alexander. He was honoured after his death as a model of endurance and holiness.
saints.knownFor: His long episcopate and holiness at Jerusalem.
